recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-subject portrait set against a twilight landscape, featuring a large foreground figure on the left and a smaller mid-ground figure on the right, unified by a custom monoline script logo in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject scale vs mid-ground subject scale creates depth
Warm sunset horizon line bisects the composition horizontally
White monoline lettering contrasts against the deep blue sky
Soft, diffused lighting creates a nostalgic, hazy atmosphere
coreInvariants: Horizontal color banding in the sky (blue to orange)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject dominates the left third in a medium-close shot; secondary subject occupies the right third in a medium shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white lettering in the upper right balances the heavy visual weight of the foreground subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the foreground face, follows the horizon line to the second subject, then moves upward to the script logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, silhouetted ground provides a heavy base, while the sky offers open space for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and navy blue in the upper sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and orange along the horizon line.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the graphic lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the subjects' clothing (pale blues and greens) allows the sunset glow to pop.

letterConstructionRules: Long horizontal swash underlining the top line of text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature large, circular loops
Terminal strokes extend into long, decorative tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style custom script used for all text elements to maintain a cohesive brand mark.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the continuous wire-like flow of the original lettering.
Captures the specific era-appropriate decorative loops.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus photograph of two men in 1970s attire (denim and patterned shirts) standing in a field at dusk. One man is in the close foreground left, looking back over his shoulder. The other is in the mid-ground right. The sky is a gradient of deep blue to orange sunset. Muted, grainy film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom white monoline script logo in the upper right. The text should be stacked in two lines with long, looping decorative swashes that underline the words.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering a consistent monoline weight?
Does the sky transition from blue to orange?
Is there a clear scale difference between the two subjects?
Is the overall image texture soft and slightly grainy?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the decorative loops.
Check that the foreground subject does not obscure the horizon line completely.
Verify the color palette remains within the twilight spectrum.
Confirm the monoline script has no thick-to-thin variation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dual-depth portrait in a natural landscape with a high-contrast, monolinear decorative script placed in the negative space of the sky.
